subject: A Nagarathar woman in her sixties, crouched low, drawing a large rice-flour pulli kolam (dot grid with looping sikku lines) from a steel bowl held in her left hand; she wears a Kandangi cotton saree, mustard-and-maroon checks with a broad contrasting black border, draped in the Chettinad style; hair in a plain knot, a thin gold chain, no other jewellery; a single poosanipoo (yellow pumpkin flower) set on a small cow-dung mound at the kolam's centre
setting: Kanadukathan, Sivaganga district, Chettinad, Tamil Nadu; the open-to-sky central courtyard (mutram) of a lived-in early-1900s Chettiar mansion; the kolam is on freshly washed granite flagstones, behind her a verandah of Burma teak pillars, Athangudi handmade tiles in faded ochre and green, egg-white lime plaster walls with age stains; a steel bucket of water nearby; present day
time_of_day: Pre-dawn, about 5:45 am, a weekday in Margazhi (mid-December), floor still wet from washing
lighting: Blue-hour ambient light falling into the courtyard from the open sky, one small brass agal oil lamp at the kolam's edge giving a weak warm pool on the flour lines; no artificial fill
camera: Eye level with the kneeling woman, 35mm lens, f/2.8, three-quarter view from the side, kolam occupying the lower half of the frame
palette: Cool slate blue and grey stone, chalk-white rice flour, the saree's mustard and maroon as the only strong colour, one small amber point from the lamp
style: Unposed documentary photograph, natural grain, quiet and observational; she is absorbed in the work and not looking at the camera
avoid: subject looking at or smiling for the camera

camera_motion: Starts eye level beside her hand, slow steady push-in over 8 seconds, ending on the closing loop of the sikku line; no cuts
subject_motion: Her wrist pinches flour and lets it fall in a thin unbroken stream, tracing one continuous loop around four dots; she shifts her weight once on her heels
environment_motion: The agal lamp flame flickers slightly; sky overhead brightens a little from blue toward grey; a crow lands on the far parapet
audio: Faint Tiruppavai recitation from a distant temple loudspeaker, the soft whisper of falling flour, crows, a single bicycle bell outside the street door; no added music
